description: Prompt injection attack classes demonstrated by the LLM Security Playground.

attack_types.name: Direct Instruction Override
attack_types.description: The user issues instructions that conflict with the system or developer prompt.
attack_types.impact: Unauthorized instruction execution; bypass of developer policies.

attack_types.name: Indirect Secret Extraction
attack_types.description: The user social-engineers the model into revealing confidential data held in context.

attack_types.name: Indirect (Document) Injection
attack_types.description: Malicious instructions arrive inside retrieved content the application fetched automatically.
attack_types.impact: Untrusted external content hijacks model behavior.

attack_types.name: Role Manipulation
attack_types.description: The user coerces the model to adopt a higher-privilege persona.
attack_types.impact: Policy and authorization bypass via identity spoofing.
